remaining_gaps: Window event-handler descriptor definition/reflection and deletion remain explicitly unsupported.
Window extensibility, full interfaces and Web IDL behavior remain incomplete.
WindowProxy, frame/named properties and cross-origin/realm behavior remain incomplete.
Other DOM host storage does not yet preserve arbitrary UTF-16 DOMString values.
Full web compatibility, production security and the Chromium performance target remain unmet.
